case.component: FORWARD COLLISION AVOIDANCE: AUTOMATIC EMERGENCY BRAKING
case.narrative: Jeep performed over the air update to the telematics box module. After update the vehicle, while in drive and running, driving on a public road way, set off a dash message to “place car in park to start”. Then suddenly can to a very violent stop in traffic. This could have cause an accident or loss of life. Vehicle is at jeep dealer waiting on fix. Thousands of 4xE hybrid jeeps are effected.

decision.rationale: Safety flag stands; the case keeps priority for a live engineer.
